The sheet has bold authorial page 23 and thin secondary foliation 46. It is handwritten text, with no diagram or drawing. Four live insertions are attached explicitly: étudier replaces regarder; a curved leader links anabéliens to after élémentaires; K ext. replaces doubtful cancelled de nombres; sans hyp replaces il suffit. The page proposes studying elementary anabelian models and general K(π,1) models, then sets aside mixed models over finite-type extensions of Q. The first de/des before tels remains doubtful with de primary; the later des after Si U,V sont is retained. Passons pour le moment sur cette situation mixte and son action are retained. The compressed word at the right edge is retained as doubtful dotless homph, without expansion. The earlier hom. after du has a real point, whereas the final hom lacks one. Both ellipses contain three points, and nothing is supplied after the final expression. check_events.outcome: At the group level only, take r:S3→S3 to be sign followed by the homomorphic section C2→S3 sending the nontrivial class to (12). The commutator subgroup is A3: sign kills commutators, and a commutator of transpositions is a nontrivial 3-cycle generating A3. Thus S3^ab=C2. Both id and r induce id on C2, but their image orders are 6 and 2, so they cannot be conjugate by a target element. This illustrates loss of information under abelianization only; it does not verify the geometric reconstruction claims.
